scope: Synthetic-only numeric verification of the shared empirical inverse-quantile interpolation correction.

tie_reproduction.source: Repeat each row of default_rng(7312).normal(size=(8,24)) 512 times.
tie_reproduction.quantile_probabilities: linspace(0,1,1025); linear inverse on sorted source values
tie_reproduction.train_for_calibration_replay: The next 2x24 normal values from the same RNG; one condition, label0.

input_recipe: Using one default_rng(20261020), draw lognormal(0,.5,(8192,1)), then lognormal(-1,.6,(8192,1)), then normal(0,.025,(8192,96)).
After these input draws, draw direct-inverse probabilities rng.random((6400,96)); invert against sorted float64 x[:4096].
float32_replay_settings.calibration_transform_input: The OLD generated copula array cast to float32, held identical for old/new maps.
float32_replay_settings.labels_order: repeat([0,1],4096) for training/reference; repeat([0,1],3200) for generation/transform.

covered_edges: Finite opposite-sign float64 extremes without overflowing subtraction
Ordered random finite knots and segment boundaries
Exact endpoints and manual linear-quantile oracle
verification.timing_note: Only the observed pytest-reported durations were retained; the numeric replay was not separately timed. These are not performance benchmarks.

provenance_limits: Ongoing pinned validation jobs use the old interpolation implementation and retain its original source/output hashes.
The final freeze must use the corrected source and record its exact source and sealed-array hashes. Existing fitted maps may be loaded, but their transforms now use the corrected shared primitive.
The maximum observed synthetic output difference was 4.440892098500626e-16; this does not establish equality or a bound for actual-study arrays, metrics, hashes, or conclusions.
Float32 compressed/source/target knots were bit-identical only in this synthetic replay; generated/transformed float64 arrays changed byte hashes.
No actual-study reevaluation or statistical equivalence claim is made. The synthetic archive is an intermediate evidence artifact; reproducible settings and scalar outcomes are retained here.
